description: A planning trap for greedy dispatch (M7). Eastside Hospital (H1, Cedar & 1st) is off the grid with 17 minutes of fuel. The only truck is empty, parked at the West Yard depot (D2, Alder & 1st). The depot nearest the hospital is South Yard (D1, Cedar & 2nd), but driving there first takes 8 minutes; loading where the truck already is and driving 6 minutes lands the fuel at minute 16 instead of 20.
